16387.name: Flametongue Totem
16387.description: Summons a Flametongue Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster. The totem enhances the melee attacks of all party or raid members within 30 yards. Each main hand hit causes ${1363/77*$<mult>-1} to ${1363/25*$<mult>} additional Fire damage, based on the speed of the weapon. Slower weapons cause more fire damage per swing. Lasts 5 min.

17354.name: Mana Tide Totem
17354.description: Summons a Mana Tide Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster for ${13 sec-1} sec that restores 133 mana every 3 seconds to group members within 30 yards.

17359.name: Mana Tide Totem
17359.description: Summons a Mana Tide Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster for ${13 sec-1} sec that restores 197 mana every 3 seconds to group members within 30 yards.

17364.name: Stormstrike
17364.description: Instantly strike for normal weapon damage and increase the damage you deal to the target with your next Lightning Bolt, Chain Lightning, or Earth Shock spell by 20% for 12 sec.

20608.name: Reincarnation
20608.description: Allows you to resurrect yourself upon death with 20% health and mana.

20609.name: Ancestral Spirit
20609.description: Returns the spirit to the body, restoring a dead target to life with 150 health and $q1 mana.  Cannot be cast when in combat.

20610.name: Ancestral Spirit

20777.name: Ancestral Spirit

25359.name: Grace of Air Totem
25359.description: Summons a Grace of Air Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster.  The totem increases the agility of party or raid members within 30 yards by 89.  Lasts 5 min.

25361.name: Strength of Earth Totem
25361.description: Summons a Strength of Earth Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster.  The totem increases the strength of party or raid members within 30 yards by 53.  Lasts 5 min.

27623.name: Fire Nova Totem
27623.description: Summons a Fire Nova Totem that has 5 health and lasts 5 sec.  Unless it is destroyed within 4 sec., the totem inflicts 419 fire damage to enemies within 10 yd.

36936.name: Totemic Recall
36936.description: Returns your totems to the earth, giving you 25% of the mana required to cast each totem destroyed by Totemic Recall.

66842.name: Call of the Elements
66842.description: Simultaneously places up to 4 totems specified in the Totem Bar.

66843.name: Call of the Ancestors
66843.description: Simultaneously places up to 4 totems specified in the Totem Bar. Can call different totems than Call of the Elements.

66844.name: Call of the Spirits
66844.description: Simultaneously places up to 4 totems specified in the Totem Bar. Can call different totems than Call of the Elements or Call of the Ancestors.
